content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CAU Young Professional I Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Central Agricultural University (CAU). It is a government organization offering opportunities in the agricultural sector.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for the CAU recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Young Professional-I. This position is open for eligible candidates seeking contractual employment.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Young Professional-I?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Young Professional-I post in this recruitment drive. Interested candidates should apply promptly.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Young Professional-I post is "Walk-in". Candidates need to attend an interview directly on the specified date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date for CAU Young Professional-I?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Young Professional-I position is scheduled for 24 September 2026. Candidates must report on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for Young Professional-I?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.F.Sc (Bachelor of Fisheries Science) qualification to be eligible for the Young Professional-I post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for the Young Professional-I post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Young Professional-I post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government norms for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Young Professional-I at CAU?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for Young Professional-I will receive a salary of Rs. 30000 Per Month. This is a consolidated salary for the contractual position.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Young Professional-I walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Central Agricultural University (CAU)?
faq.answer: The official website for Central Agricultural University (CAU) is www.cofcau.nic.in. Candidates can visit the website for more information and updates.
